Chittagong Freedom Fighter Haris
2014-11-10T00:00:55+06:00 | Zaid Kalam
https://www.thedailystar.net/chittagong-freedom-fighter-haris-54471

Freedom Fighter Md Haris and and his team members used to conduct operations against Pakistani army and their local collaborators under joint command in Chittagong city during the Liberation War in 1971.
